faq.headline: Questions
faq.a1: Yes — the web app and the desktop apps, during early access. If that changes, we'll announce the price first, and nothing you've entered will be locked away.
faq.a2: On your device. The web app keeps it in your browser's storage; the desktop app keeps it on your computer. There's no account and no copy on a server.
faq.q3: How do I back up, or move to another device?
faq.a3: Export a backup from Settings, then import it on the other device. Your data lives only on your device, so clearing your browser data or uninstalling the app deletes it — export a backup first.
faq.q4: Can I track more than one business?
faq.a4: Yes. Give each business its own profile, with its own clients, numbers and documents, and switch between them in one click.
faq.a5: {currencies}. Each amount keeps the currency it was earned in, and totals are shown per currency — never converted behind your back.
faq.q6: Web app or desktop — and does it work offline, or on my phone?
faq.a6: It's the same app either way. The web app works offline after your first visit and runs on phones. The desktop apps for Mac with Apple Silicon and for Windows keep your data outside the browser and update themselves.
